questions.q: What is the multiplier for R-1 Inside (Regular) Lot?
questions.n: R-1 Inside lots have the strictest footprint at 50%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for R-1 Corner Lot?
questions.n: Corner lots in R-1 allow for a 10% increase over Inside lots.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Basic R-2 Inside Lot?
questions.n: Basic R-2 Inside lots allow 60% coverage over 3 floors.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Basic R-2 Corner Lot?
questions.n: Standard footprint for Basic R-2 non-inside lots.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Maximum R-2 Inside Lot?
questions.n: Max R-2 increases height to 5 storeys while maintaining the 60% Inside lot footprint.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Maximum R-2 Corner Lot?
questions.n: Max R-2 height is 5 floors and Corner footprint is 70%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Basic R-3 Inside Lot?
questions.n: Basic R-3 standardizes at 70% even for Inside lots.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Maximum R-3 Corner Lot?
questions.n: Max R-3 jumps to 12 floors and 80% coverage.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for R-4 Inside Lot?
questions.n: R-4 (Townhouses) is consistently 3 floors at 80% coverage.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for R-5 Corner-Through Lot?
questions.n: R-5 (Condominiums) has a uniform 80% footprint regardless of lot type.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-1 Inside Lot (without firewalls)?
questions.n: Standard Commercial Inside lots are restricted to 75%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-1 Corner Lot (without firewalls)?
questions.n: Standard footprint for Com-1 Corner lots.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-2 Through Lot (without firewalls)?
questions.n: Com-2 Through lots share the 80% footprint standard.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-3 Corner-Through Lot (without firewalls)?
questions.n: Multi-frontage commercial lots get a 90% allowance standard.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-1 Inside Lot (With Sprinklers & Firewalls)?
questions.n: Firewalls increase the Inside lot footprint from 75% to 85%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-2 Corner Lot (With Sprinklers & Firewalls)?
questions.n: Corner lots with firewalls move from 80% to 85%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-3 Through Lot (With Sprinklers & Firewalls)?
questions.n: Through lots with fire protection reach 90% coverage.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Com-1 Multi-Frontage Lot (With Sprinklers & Firewalls)?
questions.n: The maximum possible footprint in the code is 95%.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for R-1 Through Lot?
questions.n: Through lots in R-1 follow the standard 60% coverage.

questions.q: What is the multiplier for Basic R-3 Corner-Through Lot?
questions.n: All lot types in Basic R-3 use 70% coverage.
